entity: Phelps Dodge Corporation, Western Exploration Office, Arizona
stance_basis: paraphrased as requesting miners be exempt from ORV regulations
summary: Phelps Dodge Corporation, Western Exploration Office, Arizona submitted a comment requesting that miners be exempt from ORV regulations under Executive Order 11644. Their position was part of a broader group of at least 15 mining industry commenters objecting to permit requirements and regulations being applied to mining vehicles. The Department of the Interior responded by excepting mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles in the final environmental statement.
